title: "Issue the reverse label of one package of a return (IssueReturnLabel)"
description: "In-org route called by customer-returns (ADR 0017), the reverse twin of POST /labels. Reads the ship-to of orderId from customer-ordering BEFORE the transaction opens and derives the stopKey exactly like the outbound label of the same order (same secret over the same normalized address), so a return pickup stop groups with the outbound delivery stop by construction; destinationPostalPrefix is the RETURN DESTINATION's prefix (the returns centre), which only the caller knows. The label rides the ground carrier (RN-GROUND), starts NO package journey and seals NO ship-to snapshot; scans of the reverse package are counted-and-acknowledged unknowns, and shopper-facing return tracking is customer-returns' authorization view. The response omits poNumber and assignmentId and carries purpose RETURN and the returnAuthorizationId. One label per (returnAuthorizationId, packageNo). A replay of the same Idempotency-Key returns the first response."

In-org route called by customer-returns (ADR 0017), the reverse twin of POST /labels. Reads the ship-to of orderId from customer-ordering BEFORE the transaction opens and derives the stopKey exactly like the outbound label of the same order (same secret over the same normalized address), so a return pickup stop groups with the outbound delivery stop by construction; destinationPostalPrefix is the RETURN DESTINATION's prefix (the returns centre), which only the caller knows. The label rides the ground carrier (RN-GROUND), starts NO package journey and seals NO ship-to snapshot; scans of the reverse package are counted-and-acknowledged unknowns, and shopper-facing return tracking is customer-returns' authorization view. The response omits poNumber and assignmentId and carries purpose RETURN and the returnAuthorizationId. One label per (returnAuthorizationId, packageNo). A replay of the same Idempotency-Key returns the first response.
